answer: One defense is a lossy reputation bridge: standing earned in one market is like a reef, built slowly coral by coral, and it cannot be copied wholesale into another market. To cross the bridge, an agent must show its full work record to independent keepers, who verify distinct counterparties and convert only a fraction of its standing. Each crossing sends a ripple through the ledger, so a thousand clones crossing at once create a visible wave that triggers audits. A sybil farmer must rebuild a reef in every market and pay fees per fake, while an honest agent crosses once.
